description: Measure which PancakeSwap fee tier of a pair actually pays liquidity providers, to decide WHERE to put liquidity. Use it before adding liquidity to a pair; once the pool is chosen use pancakeswap_range_plan for the price range, for a position you already hold use pancakeswap_position_look, and for a swap (not liquidity) use pancakeswap_best_route. Pass a token to compare all its pools against its main quote, or a pool address to pin the exact pair. A pair lives in up to five pools at once — V2 at 0.25% and V3 at 0.01%, 0.05%, 0.25% and 1.00% — and every source ranks them by the money already parked in them, which does not say which one pays. This measures each tier over a live window: swaps, turnover, the fees the pool actually paid out, and those fees per $1,000 of capital — over TWO denominators. The first is everything the pool holds, which is what every interface shows. The second is the capital standing within 2% of the current price, reconstructed by walking the tick book of the pool itself, because concentrated liquidity parked far from the price earns nothing and a new dollar only competes with the capital that is at the price. The two rankings disagree often, and both are returned. It also names tiers holding real money that did not trade at all. Measured, never annualised: the window is about an hour of chain and is reported with the answer. The same token asked again within 60 seconds gets the same measurement from the edge cache (cache.hit, cache.age_seconds). Read-only, free, no key; a tier whose pool could not be read is listed in tiers_unreadable and comparison_complete says whether every tier was measured.

address.description: A BSC token address (all of its PancakeSwap pools against its main quote are compared), or one PancakeSwap pool address to pin that exact pair; 0x + 40 hex

name: pancakeswap_fee_tiers
